VOICE 3.0 / TEXT ONLY Only the top transcript is accepted.

Fast, but competing interpretations are discarded.

VOICE 4.0 / EVIDENCE AWARE Audio and alternate hypotheses are retained.

The agent can confirm uncertainty before committing a critical value.

Live browser-recognition MVP. Production phonemes and accent robustness require a dedicated speech-model backend.

PROPOSED MVP ARCHITECTURE

Preserve first. Reason second.

The transcript stays useful. It simply stops being the only source of truth.

01 / CAPTURE

Raw audio buffer

Retain short, timestamped clips around uncertain or business-critical speech.

02 / EXTRACT

Parallel evidence

Produce transcript confidence, phonemes, timing, acoustic cues, and candidates.

03 / RESOLVE

Contextual agent

Combine the evidence with the task and conversation state before committing.

04 / RESPOND

Targeted clarification

Ask one natural question only when the uncertainty can change the outcome.
